sources: https://secure.rec1.com/WY/natrona-county-wy/catalog (Natrona County Parks Rec1 catalog, public getItems/getLocationFacilities JSON, read 2026-11-20): Pathfinder Reservoir tab: 'Pathfinder Reservoir now offers one reservation only campground - Diabase, all the other campgrounds are still first come, first served.' / 'Restroom facilities are provided at each Pathfinder Reservoir Campground.'; group 'Weiss (First Come, First Served)': 'First Come, First Served. $15.00 a night. Weiss Campground is located off of Natrona County Road 409 Pathfinder Road to the west of Pathfinder Dam. Campground information and pay boxes are located at multiple kiosks along the roadside of each Natrona County Park. Weiss has sheltered and non-sheltered campsites. ADA accessible campsites are also available with beautiful views and easy access and restroom facilities are available. Weiss Campground is closest to the Pathfinder Dam, and trail complex. A RV dump site is available. Please note that water levels vary greatly at Pathfinder Reservoir. Campsites may be at the water's edge one year and 1,500 feet away from the water another year.'; facility 'Weiss Non-Reservable Sites' Nightly Rate base fee $13.39 (before tax)

Rec1 catalog Terms & Conditions (same page, read 2026-11-20): 'Each camping unit or individual is permitted to camp for a maximum of ten (10) days in any one campground. note: Natrona County campground on Pathfinder Reservoir just west of Pathfinder Dam, off County Road 409 (Pathfinder Road); the closest campground to the dam and its interpretive trail. Sheltered and open sites, ADA sites, restrooms; no water or hookups; the RV dump is a quarter mile away on the county road. Water levels vary greatly: sites may be at the water's edge one year and 1,500 feet from it another. --Claude
